notes: Budgeted delivery E2, budget sizing at $0: re-import with hash vectors and the reranker off (delivery reads no vector; every frozen chunk is re-resolved and its text checked), then the E2 sizing deliveries on the frozen lists. No provider call is expected; the lease covers none.

cells.lease_basis: no provider call expected (hash vectors, reranker off)
cells.command: ( bash eval/runner/budgeted-delivery/e2-parallel.sh 24 "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/lme-s" -- --benchmark lme-s --system gbrain-query --embed hash --embedding-model openai:text-embedding-3-large --embedding-dims 1536 --config search.reranker.enabled=false --gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master@{{gbrain_sha}}" --arms docs/benchmarks/2026-10-09-gbrain-budgeted-delivery-e2/manifests/arms/retrieval-only.json --policy-setting variants=e2 --policy-setting stage=size --policy-setting grid=4000:7000:100 --frozen-from .e2-transfer/lme-s/frozen.ndjson ) & pa=$!; ( bash eval/runner/budgeted-delivery/e2-parallel.sh 6 "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/lme-s-slice16" -- --benchmark lme-s --limit 100 --seed 42 --system gbrain-query --embed hash --embedding-model openai:text-embedding-3-large --embedding-dims 1536 --config search.reranker.enabled=false --gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master@{{gbrain_sha}}" --arms docs/benchmarks/2026-10-09-gbrain-budgeted-delivery-e2/manifests/arms/retrieval-only.json --policy-setting variants=e2 --policy-setting stage=size --policy-setting grid16=9000:13500:100 --frozen-from .e2-transfer/lme-s/frozen.ndjson ) & pb=$!; wait $pa; ra=$?; wait $pb; rb=$?; exit $((ra | rb))
cells.setup_command: BUN_VERSION=1.4.2 bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh setup --datasets lme-s && { test -d "$HOME/gbrain-master/.git" || git clone -q https://github.com/garrytan/gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master"; } && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" fetch -q origin {{gbrain_sha}} && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" checkout -q {{gbrain_sha}}
